environment: GitHub standard Ubuntu runner; official Playwright Chromium
evidencePolicy: Explicit safe screenshots and reduced observations only; no trace, HAR, video, cookies, recovery codes, database or raw network bodies

tests.title: two isolated browsers finish a human UI match with summons attacks English and reconnect
annotations: Automated browser UI driven PvP: genuine pointer card selection, keyboard I/Enter, summons, attacks, first visible English choices, short offline/reload recovery, health/draw terminal state with no proxy assistance.

tests.title: an unmatched guest waits the real default ten seconds before the declared AI fallback
annotations: Real default 10-second matchmaking wait and explicitly identified AI fallback; this is not a completed browser game or a timeout-proxy test.

tests.title: account and guest progress stay separate across login logout and a real SQLite server restart
annotations: Visible learning and test collection persist for a registered account across fresh-context login and a real server process restart; original guest progress stays isolated; unfinished room is interrupted rather than fabricated.

tests.title: 320 and 390 portrait plus 844 by 390 landscape expose readable real UI screenshots
annotations: Chromium viewport emulation: 320x740 and 390x844 portrait; 844x390 landscape. Real UI clicks and bounded layout checks; no claim of physical touch-device, whole-session FPS or pixel-perfect visual approval.
